definitions.short: a Tsorite or inhabitant of Tsor (i.e. Syrian)
definitions.full: H6876. Tsori צֹרִי adjective, of a people Tyrilan ; — צ ׳אִישׁ 1Kin 7:14 2Chr 2:13 ; plural as substantive הַצֹּרִים the Tyrians 1Chr 22:4 ; Ezra 3:7 (both + הַצִּידֹנִים ), Neh 13:16 . II. צֹר ( flint, knife ) see III. צרר .
